message: Iba a coger el bus y me encontré el agua estancada junto al paradero, en la cuadra que sale a la avenida, aquí en Kennedy. Pilas los que vienen por ese lado. #Bogota #inundacion

attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0010: Amateur landscape smartphone photograph from beneath the roof of a small bus-stop shelter in Kennedy, Bogotá. Still shallow brown water gathered beside the shelter at the end of a residential block leading toward a wider avenue, distant blue city bus on the dry avenue. Bench in near right foreground, wet concrete, rainsoft focus in distance; no readable signage or transport logos. Safe waiting spot.
